description_en: Invokes a specified service on a single device
description_zh: 调用该接口在单个设备上调用指定服务
kebab_example: aliyun iot invoke-thing-service --identifier Set --args param1_:1 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: InvokeThingService

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. On the Overview page in the IoT Platform console, view the ID of the current instance.

<notice>
If the ID value is displayed, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
If the Overview page or ID value is not displayed, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无实例概览页面或ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ProductKey of the product to which the device belongs.
<notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify DeviceName.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
要调用服务的设备所属的产品ProductKey。
<notice> 如果传入该参数，需同时传入DeviceName。
</notice>
parameters.name: product_key

parameters.help_en:
The DeviceName of the device on which you want to invoke the service.
<notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify ProductKey.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
要调用服务所属设备的DeviceName。
<notice> 如果传入该参数，需同时传入ProductKey。
</notice>
parameters.name: device_name

parameters.help_en:
The identifier of the service.

To view the Identifier of a device service:

Log on to the IoT Platform console (https://iot.console.aliyun.com/) and view the identifier in the Define Feature section of the product to which the device belongs.
Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/150321.html operation and view the identifier in the returned TSL model information.

If the service testService belongs to a custom (non-default) module testFb, set this parameter to testFb:testService
parameters.help_zh:
服务的标识符。

设备的服务Identifier的查看方式：

登录物联网平台控制台 (https://iot.console.aliyun.com/)，在设备所属产品的功能定义中查看。
调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/150321.html，从返回的物模型信息中查看。

如果是自定义（非默认）模块testFb下服务testService，则参数值为testFb:testService
parameters.name: identifier

parameters.help_en:
The input parameters of the service to invoke. The data is in JSON string format, such as Args={"param1":1}.
If this parameter is empty, pass Args={}.

<notice>If the data type defined in the TSL model is float or double, the corresponding parameter value (even if it is an integer) must contain at least one decimal place. For example, 10.0 or 11.1.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
要启用服务的入参信息，数据格式为JSON String，例如Args={"param1":1}。
若此参数为空时，需传入 Args={} 。

<notice>物模型功能定义数据类型为float或double时，对应参数值（即使值为整数）至少携带一位小数位。例如10.0、11.1。
</notice>
parameters.name: args

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the device on which you want to invoke the service. This is the unique identifier issued by IoT Platform for the device.
<notice> IotId is the unique identifier of a device and corresponds one-to-one with the combination of ProductKey and DeviceName. If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify ProductKey or DeviceName. If you specify IotId together with ProductKey and DeviceName, IotId takes precedence.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
要调用服务的设备ID。物联网平台为该设备颁发的ID，设备的唯一标识符。
<notice> IotId作为设备唯一标识符，和ProductKey与DeviceName组合是一一对应的关系。如果传入该参数，则无需传入ProductKey和DeviceName。如果您同时传入IotId和ProductKey与DeviceName组合，则以IotId为准。
</notice>
parameters.name: iot_id

Code.description_en: The error code returned if the call fails. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）
Code.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误码。更多信息，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）

Data.description_en: The data returned if the call is successful
Data.description_zh: 调用成功时，返回的数据

MessageId.description_en: The message ID of the service invocation request sent from the cloud to the device
MessageId.description_zh: 云端向设备下发服务调用的消息ID

Result.description_en:
The result returned for a synchronous invocation of a service.
This parameter is not returned for asynchronous invocation of a service
Result.description_zh:
同步调用服务，返回的调用结果。
异步调用服务，不返回此参数

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call is successful.
true: The call is successful, but this does not mean the invoked service is executed successfully. Check the device logs for the execution status.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。
true：调用成功，但不代表调用的服务执行成功。执行情况，以设备端日志为准。
false：调用失败
